--- Page 1 (Beckerman_19a) --- March 16, 1945 Dear Jack, We were glad to receive your letters of March 14 this week and hear of your latest doings. Did any of the beasts show out of their sanctuary on that trip? Well, today Friday puts another week behind us, a week of rather the usual occurrences, with nothing much new happening — except that today, May 16 goes across my mind — a very hot day, we've got it, feel like a steamhouse, coming so suddenly and catching --- Page 2 (Beckerman_19b) --- us all unprepared. I've finally got that second record sent off. This time the clerk was less inquisitive about the extra inches, and so it got by with little trouble; now we hope it gets to you with no cracks. We're hearing from Abe again, after a 10 day interval, and everything there seems to be going well, and we understand it's a rather nice area they're set up in. Not... when I was new to the neighborhood - the same faces and the same scenes.... --- Page 3 (Beckerman_19c) --- Reading some of Sarah's mail we learn that Jack has just made a trip to Cuba, but is already headed back to Hawaii. And we're keeping Moishe pretty busy with sending him packages that he in turn mails to a lot of our relatives who are in France. That seems to be the quickest way and they certainly need all the food and clothing they can get. Tomorrow is a pretty big day in our 'list of events' at the New York Ballroom at the Hotel New Yorker, in honor of the 23rd --- Page 4 (Beckerman_19d) --- wedding anniversary of some "landslait". It should be a nice affair, but Mama and Papa beat them too it quite a while ago! - Not much more to write today, except that all [illegible] are feeling fine! Love and Regards Mama Papa Ruth
